{"dataset_name":"blood_transfusion","model_family":"tree","schema_generator":"gpt-5.5-pro","schema_version":"1.0.0","features":[{"name":"recency_bucket_ord","type":"formula","description":"Ordinal recency bucket from V1: 0 for 0-2 months, 1 for 3-11, 2 for 12-23, 3 for 24 or more.","value_range":[0,3],"feature_family":"recency_bucket","expected_model_benefit":"Gives a tree stable recency tiers instead of relying only on many fine V1 cuts.","leakage_risk":"low","uses_only_row_values":true,"formula":"np.where(V1 >= 24, 3, np.where(V1 >= 12, 2, np.where(V1 >= 3, 1, 0)))"},{"name":"donation_count_bucket_ord","type":"formula","description":"Ordinal count bucket from V2: 0 for 1 donation, 1 for 2-4, 2 for 5-9, 3 for 10 or more.","value_range":[0,3],"feature_family":"frequency_bucket","expected_model_benefit":"Compresses skewed donation counts into stable ordered tiers that are easy to split.","leakage_risk":"low","uses_only_row_values":true,"formula":"np.where(V2 >= 10, 3, np.where(V2 >= 5, 2, np.where(V2 >= 2, 1, 0)))"},{"name":"tenure_span_bucket_ord","type":"formula","description":"Ordinal months-since-first-donation bucket from V4: 0 for under 12, 1 for 12-35, 2 for 36-59, 3 for 60 or more.","value_range":[0,3],"feature_family":"tenure_bucket","expected_model_benefit":"Encodes history length as coarse levels, reducing sensitivity to high-end outliers.","leakage_risk":"low","uses_only_row_values":true,"formula":"np.where(V4 >= 60, 3, np.where(V4 >= 36, 2, np.where(V4 >= 12, 1, 0)))"},{"name":"active_span_months","type":"formula","description":"Nonnegative estimated months between first and most recent donation, using V4 minus V1 clipped at zero.","value_range":[0,98],"feature_family":"time_span","expected_model_benefit":"Separates long participation spans from one-episode histories and supports interaction with count features.","leakage_risk":"low","uses_only_row_values":true,"formula":"np.maximum(V4 - V1, 0)"},{"name":"donation_density_per_month","type":"formula","description":"Donation count per recorded month, using V2 divided by V4 plus one for stability.","value_range":[0.0101,14.6667],"feature_family":"rate_ratio","expected_model_benefit":"Adds an intensity ratio that trees can split on directly beyond raw count and span.","leakage_risk":"low","uses_only_row_values":true,"formula":"V2 / (V4 + 1.0)"},{"name":"recency_span_ratio_clipped","type":"formula","description":"Current gap as a clipped share of recorded span, using V1 divided by V4 plus one and capped at 1.","value_range":[0.0,1.0],"feature_family":"relative_recency","expected_model_benefit":"Captures proportional staleness rather than only absolute month count.","leakage_risk":"low","uses_only_row_values":true,"formula":"np.clip(V1 / (V4 + 1.0), 0.0, 1.0)"},{"name":"average_months_per_donation","type":"formula","description":"Average recorded months per donation, computed as V4 divided by V2.","value_range":[0.045,98.0],"feature_family":"cadence_ratio","expected_model_benefit":"Exposes donation cadence so a tree can split between tightly spaced and sparse histories.","leakage_risk":"low","uses_only_row_values":true,"formula":"V4 / V2"},{"name":"total_volume_bucket_ord","type":"formula","description":"Ordinal total volume bucket from V3: 0 for under 500, 1 for 500-999, 2 for 1000-2499, 3 for 2500 or more.","value_range":[0,3],"feature_family":"volume_bucket","expected_model_benefit":"Turns total volume into coarse interpretable tiers aligned with direct split points.","leakage_risk":"low","uses_only_row_values":true,"formula":"np.where(V3 >= 2500.0, 3, np.where(V3 >= 1000.0, 2, np.where(V3 >= 500.0, 1, 0)))"},{"name":"recent_regular_activity_flag","type":"formula","description":"Binary interaction indicator for short recency and repeated donations: V1 at most 6 and V2 at least 5.","value_range":[0,1],"feature_family":"nonlinear_interaction","expected_model_benefit":"Represents a useful conjunction in one feature, reducing the number of splits needed.","leakage_risk":"low","uses_only_row_values":true,"formula":"np.where((V1 <= 6) & (V2 >= 5), 1, 0)"},{"name":"long_span_sparse_activity_flag","type":"formula","description":"Binary interaction indicator for long recorded span and few donations: V4 at least 36 and V2 at most 2.","value_range":[0,1],"feature_family":"nonlinear_interaction","expected_model_benefit":"Exposes sparse-history patterns that may be missed by separate span and count splits.","leakage_risk":"low","uses_only_row_values":true,"formula":"np.where((V4 >= 36) & (V2 <= 2), 1, 0)"},{"name":"donor_lifecycle_stage_score","type":"judgment","description":"Semantic ordinal score from 0 to 4 assigned from V1, V2, V3, and V4 only: 0 means one-off or dormant, 2 means intermittent, 4 means sustained and recently active.","value_range":[0,4],"feature_family":"semantic_lifecycle","expected_model_benefit":"Provides a compact expert-style summary of lifecycle patterns that may require multiple raw splits.","leakage_risk":"low","uses_only_row_values":true},{"name":"reactivation_window_score","type":"judgment","description":"Semantic score from 0 to 4 assigned from V1, V2, V3, and V4 only: 0 means little prior engagement or an extreme gap, 4 means substantial prior engagement with a moderate current lapse.","value_range":[0,4],"feature_family":"semantic_reactivation","expected_model_benefit":"Adds an expert-style nonlinear grouping for comeback-like behavior by combining prior engagement and current gap length.","leakage_risk":"low","uses_only_row_values":true}]}
